criteria: web-aurora.html is one self-contained dark, futuristic 'AURORA LUXE TRAVEL' landing page (HTML+CSS+vanilla JS, no libraries): sticky glass navbar + CTA, hero with animated gradient, a destinations grid whose cards open an accessible modal (focus trap, ESC), membership tiers, a testimonials carousel, a validated concierge form with a toast, scroll reveals via IntersectionObserver, and active-section nav highlighting.

review.description: Dark luxury single-file travel landing page: glass navbar+CTA, animated hero, destinations grid with accessible modal, tiers, carousel, validated form + toast, IntersectionObserver reveals, active-nav.
